steps.title: CREATE PROJECT
steps.evidence: a create-project flow exists and returned a result

steps.title: ENTER REQUIREMENTS
steps.evidence: requirements are classified; unsupported ones stay counted, not silently satisfied

steps.title: GENERATE MODEL
steps.evidence: a real model with 6 spaces at revision rev:98df9f13d724ff1d

steps.title: EXPLORE 3D
steps.evidence: the 3D viewport is present; WebGL is available; Three.js revision 160 loaded with WebGLRenderer

steps.title: SELECT ELEMENT
steps.evidence: the element is selected and selecting wrote nothing to the model

steps.title: INSPECT PROPERTIES
steps.evidence: 6 sections, 4 values shown as unknown, 3 read-only derived, 8 provenance labels

steps.title: ENTER EDIT MODE
steps.evidence: 8 operations offered and the status bar states EDIT

steps.title: PREVIEW CHANGE
steps.evidence: a candidate model was produced while the committed model stayed byte-identical

steps.title: CANCEL A CHANGE
steps.evidence: cancelling left neither a revision nor a hash change

steps.title: COMMIT A CHANGE
steps.evidence: pressing the commit button recorded a new revision; history now holds 2 entries

steps.title: UNDO AND REDO
steps.evidence: undo produced a different model and redo restored the original hash exactly

steps.title: VIEW WARNINGS
steps.evidence: 10 issue categories and 4 issues shown, with no compliance claim in the text

steps.title: NAVIGATE FROM AN ISSUE TO THE MODEL
steps.evidence: the issue declares itself not focusable rather than inventing a target

steps.title: ASSISTANT PROPOSES WITHOUT COMMITTING
steps.evidence: a resolvable phrase produced a proposal, an unresolvable one was refused, and neither changed the model or its revision

steps.title: EXPORT
steps.evidence: 5 export kinds offered; every descriptor names the committed revision and model hash and certifies nothing

steps.title: SWITCH LANGUAGE WITHOUT LOSING STATE
steps.evidence: Arabic renders right-to-left and English left-to-right; selection, mode and model hash all survive the switch
